[LGRA.9.7.3] The type-headed coercion call forms `Json(x)` / `Float(x)` /
`Int(x)` / `<unit>(x)` are **removed**: a conversion is written with the `::`
cast ([LGRA.9.6], [LCST.4.6.1]). The compiler must reject the removed call
forms; for one language-version it emits a guided rewrite error naming the `::`
form. Ordinary `NAME(...)` calls (`len`, `has`, distance builtins) are
unaffected. `json("<lit>")` is not a coercion and is refused on its own terms
([LGRA.9.8.3]).
